changelog:
v1.1.1.X0 — 2026-06-03

[ADDED]
- AI Core Module: integrated advanced AI engine features for intelligent threat analysis and context-aware vulnerability mapping.
- Guardian & Panic System: implemented a proactive environment monitor (Guardian) coupled with an automated emergency panic routine for safe state handling.
- Self-Destruct Sequence: added a secure, high-integrity self-destruct protocol to wipe volatile data and prevent forensics in hostile environments.
- New Analysis Vectors: implemented generic, high-performance scanning functions alongside advanced decoding algorithms to handle legacy and obfuscated data streams.

v1.0.1.X1 — 2026-03-23

[FIXED]
- Centralized logging path: resolved an issue where 'debug_log/' was incorrectly generated inside the installation directory across five separate code paths. All logs are now properly routed to 'v0rtex_utils/debug_log/'. Impacted functions fixed: _setup_panic, _REQUIRED_DIRS, in-app updater, Recovery Selective Regen, and _run_silent_update_ui.

v1.0.1.X0 — 2026-03-23

[CHANGED]
- Refactored update architecture: migrated the entire Trampoline logic loop from 'v0rtex.py' to 'v0rtex_adapter.py', removing 369 lines of redundant code from the core script. The adapter now independently manages the full update chain.
- Self-updating adapter: 'v0rtex_adapter.py' now checks for and fetches its own latest release before initializing the Splash UI, auto-relaunching if a newer version is available.
- Integrated Trampoline execution: the adapter autonomously processes 'compat_map.json', silently installing intermediate versions sequentially until reaching one hop before the target, where it hands off to the standard 6-step pipeline.
- Rebranded nomenclature: updated the V0RTEX acronym definition to: Vulnerability Oriented Recon Threat Exploitation eXaminer.

v1.0.0.X0 — 2026-03-23

[ADDED]
- Introduced 'v0rtex_adapter.py': a dedicated post-update adapter featuring a robust 6-step pipeline and a live, asynchronous Tkinter Splash UI.
- Expanded NET Module: added new functional tabs for Proxy, Tor, Noise Gen, Live Traffic, Conn Stats, and Ping.
- Enhanced Analysis Tabs: implemented IMPHASH sub-tab under IOC, alongside FUZZY and BINPAT interfaces under the LOOK module.
- UI & Configuration Extensions: added UPDATE LOG (CFG), PRIVACY settings (SET), and an integrated README sub-tab (HOME).
- Advanced Log Censorship: engineered a dynamic log censor system governed by per-category filtering rules and backed by 'Temp_Log_Storage'.
- Global Exception Hooks: implemented specialized crash interceptors including _early_crash_hook, _vx_debug_excepthook, and _tk_callback_exception_handler.
- Disaster Recovery: added an Emergency Rollback feature directly accessible within PROT > BACKUP.
- System Integrity: added a comprehensive FULL SCAN sub-tab under PROT > System Check.

[FIXED]
- Exception Routing: Tkinter callback exceptions are now correctly intercepted and routed through the primary global crash handler.
- Optimization: significantly reduced cold-start initialization latency by implementing deferred tab loading.
